data.case_title: Lease end notice and extension offer – Apartment B 3.07
data.title: Lease ending 31 January 2027 – reply needed by 16 December 2026 on extension
data.summary: Beispielhof Serviced Living GmbH informs Harriet Collins that her fixed-term lease for apartment B 3.07 ends on 31 January 2027, and offers a 6- or 12-month extension at the current rent if she replies in writing by 16 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your furnished apartment lease is due to end on 31 January 2027. The landlord offers to extend it for six or twelve months at the same rent, but needs your written answer by 16 December 2026. If you want to stay, reply before that date; if you don't respond, they will plan for you to move out at the end of January. Think about whether you want to extend and for how long, and send your decision by email or letter well before the deadline.
